node.title: Residual petal pairs exclude rank nine from K'=15635
node.closure: residual root ceiling, exact owner-petal pair charge, and monotone boundary crossing
node.statement: For one fixed rank-nine residual chart, let j be the common owner-plane core size. The kernel root bound gives j<=K'-1, and exact petal counting gives W_B<=floor(981105*(n'-j)*(m'+j-20)/2). On K'<=20617 the envelope is largest at j=K'-1. The weighted selector demand first exceeds it at K'=15635 by 3381772318665, while the cap wins at K'=15634 by 1881744358235. Thus rank nine is absent on 15635..20617 and, with the separate high-row cut, remains only on 10..15634.
